note: German tax and social-security parameters for 2026, in nominal euros of 2026. Every value cites its source. The official pages were read through search-engine extracts, cross-checked in at least two; objects flagged verify have a single or only secondary source, or depend on an open question (docs/tax/DE.md, Open questions). How amounts follow prices after 2026 ("indexed"): plan (the plan's indexThresholds), fixed (nominal by law, unless the option indexFixedAllowances), wages (grow with the option realWageGrowth in today's euros, as the law sets them from wages). Nothing here depends on the person: their circumstances are options. See docs/tax/DE.md.

tariff.note: Quadratic zones: tax = (a * u + b) * u + c with u = (x - from) / 10000. Linear zones: tax = rate * x - minus. The law rounds x and the tax down to whole euros; the planner doesn't.
tariff.source: EStG §32a Abs. 1 as amended by the Steuerfortentwicklungsgesetz (BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 449), for 2026: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__32a.html; BMF Lohnsteuer-Handbuch 2026: https://esth.bundesfinanzministerium.de/lsth/2026/A-Einkommensteuergesetz/IV-Tarif-31-34b/Paragraf-32a/paragraf-32a.html

splitting.note: Joint assessment: twice the tax on half the joint income. A hook only; the planner models one person.

progressionClause.note: Exempt income (treaty-exempt foreign income) raises the rate on taxable income: tax = x * T(x + P) / (x + P). Extraordinary income within P counts at one fifth.

oneFifthRule.note: Tax on extraordinary income E = 5 * (T(x + E/5) - T(x)). Applied in the assessment only since 2025.
oneFifthRule.source: EStG §34 Abs. 1 and 2 Nr. 2; Wachstumschancengesetz (no longer applied in wage withholding from 2025)

soli.note: No Soli while income tax is at most 20,350 (Freigrenze); at most 11.9% of the income tax above it. On the flat tax on capital income, always 5.5% with no threshold.
soli.source: SolZG §3 Abs. 3 Nr. 2 (20,350 for 2026, as amended by BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 449): https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/solzg_1995/__3.html; §4 Satz 2-3: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/solzg_1995/__4.html

churchTax.note: A percentage of income tax (for a single person without children, the income tax itself). Church tax paid is a special expense; on capital income it lowers the flat rate instead. The trade-tax credit (§35) doesn't lower the church tax's base, while it lowers the Soli's.
churchTax.source: Kirchensteuergesetze der Länder; EStG §51a; EStG §32d Abs. 1 Satz 3-5 (flat rate with church tax); EStG §10 Abs. 1 Nr. 4; §51a Abs. 2 Satz 3 (no §35 credit in the church tax's base): https://dejure.org/gesetze/EStG/51a.html

pensionIncomeLumpSum.note: One amount for all income under §22 Nr. 1, 1a and 5 together.

specialExpensesLumpSum.note: Replaced by church tax paid when that is larger.

next.note: Einkommensteuerreformgesetz 2027, government bill of 2 September 2026: also 42% from 70,600, 45% from 250,000 and a new 47% from 280,000. Not law yet; for a 2027.json once passed.

retirementMaximum.note: The maximum contribution to the knappschaftliche Rentenversicherung: 124,800 * 24.7%, rounded up. Covers DRV contributions (employee and employer shares) and Rürup; the employer share is then subtracted.
retirementMaximum.source: EStG §10 Abs. 3 Satz 1-6 (100% from 2023); ceiling of the knappschaftliche RV 124,800 a year in SVBezGrV 2026: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/svbezgrv_2026/BJNR1160A0025.html

otherMaximumSelfPaid.note: For those who pay their own health insurance without an employer's subsidy (freelancers).

sickPayReduction.note: Health contributions that include a right to sick pay are reduced by 4% before deduction.
sickPayReduction.source: EStG §10 Abs. 1 Nr. 3 Buchst. a Satz 4

taxFreeIncomeSplit.note: Contributions linked to tax-free salary (Aktivrente) aren't deductible; split by the share of salary.
taxFreeIncomeSplit.source: EStG §10 Abs. 2 Satz 1 Nr. 1; BMF, Fragen und Antworten zur Aktivrente: https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/FAQ/FAQ-zur-Aktivrente.html; LOHN + GEHALT, Aktivrente: Auswirkungen auf Werbungskosten und Vorsorgeaufwendungen: https://www.lohnundgehalt-magazin.de/artikel/aktivrente-auswirkungen-auf-werbungskosten-und-vorsorgeaufwendungen-2/

wageTaxWithholding.note: The Lohnsteuer's Vorsorgepauschale from 2026: a part for unemployment insurance only within the 1,900 limit together with health and care (which those alone exceed from about 17,000 of salary), health at the reduced rate, actual PKV premiums and no minimum. For reference only: the planner computes the assessed tax. An employee with wages only must file a return under §46 Abs. 2 Nr. 3 only when more than 410 of health and care contributions were refunded.
wageTaxWithholding.source: EStG §39b Abs. 2 Satz 5 Nr. 3 (JStG 2024); BMF, Vorsorgepauschale im Lohnsteuerabzugsverfahren ab 2026 (14 August 2025): https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/Downloads/BMF_Schreiben/Steuerarten/Lohnsteuer/2025-08-14-vorsorgepau-lohnsteuerabzugsverfahren.pdf; haufe: https://www.haufe.de/steuern/finanzverwaltung/vorsorgepauschale-im-lohnsteuerabzugsverfahren-ab-2026_164_658714.html; Deloitte: https://www.deloitte-tax-news.de/steuern/arbeitnehmerbesteuerung-sozialversicherung/bmf-aenderungen-bei-der-vorsorgepauschale-ab-dem-01-01-2026.html; EStG §46 Abs. 2 Nr. 3 with §52 Abs. 36: haufe, Änderungen bei der Vorsorgepauschale und der Pflichtveranlagung: https://www.haufe.de/steuern/steuerwissen-tipps/aenderungen-bei-der-vorsorgepauschale-und-der-pflichtveranlagung_170_661648.html

pension.source: SGB VI §158 (18.6%); SVBezGrV 2026 (8,450 a month, uniform): https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/svbezgrv_2026/BJNR1160A0025.html

pensionPastStandardAge.note: Past the standard age, employees stay compulsorily insured until they draw a full old-age pension (Flexirentengesetz, from 2017). With a full pension the employer still pays its half (not credited) and the employee may opt back in.
pensionPastStandardAge.source: SGB VI §5 Abs. 4, §172 Abs. 1, §230: DRV, rvRecht on §5 SGB VI: https://rvrecht.deutsche-rentenversicherung.de/SharedDocs/rvRecht/01_GRA_SGB/06_SGB_VI/pp_0001_25/gra_sgb006_p_0005.html; haufe, Flexirentengesetz: https://www.haufe.de/id/beitrag/flexirentengesetz-beschaeftigte-rentnerhinzuverdienstregelungenausgleich-von-rentenabschlaegen-HI10449837.html

unemployment.note: Employees are free of unemployment insurance from the month after the standard retirement age; the employer still pays its half.
unemployment.source: SGB III §341 Abs. 2 (2.6%); §28 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 (employees past the standard retirement age); §346 Abs. 3 (employer share): https://haufe.de/personal/haufe-personal-office-platin/sauer-sgbiii-346-beitragstragung-bei-beschaeftigten-24-beitragstragung-bei-beschaeftigten-im-regelrentenalter-abs3_idesk_PI42323_HI2006228.html; SVBezGrV 2026

health.note: Voluntary minimum base: 1/90 of the monthly Bezugsgröße per day, 1,318.33 a month. The reduced rate applies without sick pay. Employer subsidy for PKV or voluntary GKV: half of (14.6% + 2.9%) of the monthly ceiling.
health.source: SGB V §241 (14.6%), §243 (14.0%), §242a and the BMG notice of the average Zusatzbeitrag (2.9%): https://www.bundesgesundheitsministerium.de/beitraege; §240 Abs. 4 (minimum base); §257 (subsidy); SVBezGrV 2026 (69,750; 77,400; Bezugsgröße 3,955 a month): https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/svbezgrv_2026/BJNR1160A0025.html

care.note: The surcharge is paid by the employee alone. In Saxony the employee pays 2.3% and the employer 1.3%. Pensioners pay the whole care contribution on their pensions.
care.source: SGB XI §55 Abs. 1 and 3, §58 Abs. 3, §59; rate unchanged for 2026 (vdek, Änderungen Gesundheitswesen 2026: https://www.vdek.com/politik/was-aendert-sich/gesundheitswesen-2026/_jcr_content/par/publicationelement/file.res/Aenderungen_Gesundheitswesen_2026.pdf)

childDiscount.note: Members with two or more children under 25 pay 0.25 points less for each such child from the second to the fifth (at most 1 point), on the employee's or member's share only. A child at any age ends the childless surcharge.
childDiscount.source: SGB XI §55 Abs. 3 (PUEG, from July 2023); TK: https://www.tk.de/firmenkunden/versicherung/beitraege-faq-und-mehr/pv-beitraege/bis-zu-welchem-alter-der-kinder-gelten-abschlaege-bei-pv-2148702; mobil krankenkasse: https://mobil-krankenkasse.de/krankenversicherung/beitragssaetze-und-beitragsbemessungsgrenzen/pflegeversicherungsbeitrag.html

next.note: GKV-Beitragssatzstabilisierungsgesetz, passed 10 July 2026: the health ceiling rises by 300 a month in 2027 beyond the normal adjustment. For a 2027.json.

drvVoluntary.note: Voluntary contributions: 18.6% of 603 to 8,450 a month. Standard contribution for compulsory insurance on application: 18.6% of the Bezugsgröße.
drvVoluntary.source: SGB VI §7, §4 Abs. 2, §165, §167; DRV, freiwillige Beiträge 2026: https://www.deutsche-rentenversicherung.de/DRV/DE/Ueber-uns-und-Presse/Presse/Meldungen/2026/260209-freiwillige-beitraege-rente-erhoehen

aktivrente.note: Salary of employees in work subject to social insurance (the employer pays pension contributions, at least its own half) who have reached the standard retirement age, from the month after. Not for self-employment or mini-jobs taxed at a flat rate. The 1,230 lump sum is deducted in full from the taxable salary; contributions linked to the tax-free part aren't deductible (provisions.taxFreeIncomeSplit). Social contributions stay due.
aktivrente.source: EStG §3 Nr. 21 (Aktivrentengesetz, Bundesrat 19 December 2025, from 1 January 2026); BMF, Fragen und Antworten zur Aktivrente: https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/FAQ/FAQ-zur-Aktivrente.html and FAQ of 6 February 2026: https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/Standardartikel/Themen/Steuern/2026-02-06-FAQ-Aktivrente-Anlage.pdf; steuerschroeder, Aktivrente: https://www.steuerschroeder.de/Aktivrente.html; rehm, Arbeitgeberbeiträge zur Rentenversicherung: https://www.rehm-verlag.de/lohnsteuerrecht/aktuelle-beitraege-zum-lohnsteuerrecht/aktivrente-arbeitgeberbeitraege--zuschuesse-zur-rentenversicherung/

selfEmployedExtension.note: Extending the Aktivrente to the self-employed (e.g. from 2027) is being lobbied for; no bill found.

pensionValue.note: Monthly euros per pension point. Raised by 4.24% on 1 July 2026.

pensionLevelFloor.note: The Haltelinie: pensions follow wages until 2031. Later growth is the plan assumption realPensionValueGrowth.

longInsured.note: Altersrente für langjährig Versicherte: 14.4% less at 63 for those born from 1964.
longInsured.source: SGB VI §36, §236, §77 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 Buchst. a; DRV: https://www.deutsche-rentenversicherung.de/DRV/DE/Rente/Allgemeine-Informationen/Rentenarten-und-Leistungen/Altersrente-fuer-langjaehrig-Versicherte/altersrente-fuer-langjaehrig-versicherte_node

deferralIncreasePerMonth.source: SGB VI §77 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 Buchst. b

pensionStartsMonthAfter.note: From the first of the month after the age is reached (from that month for those born on the 1st).

earningsLimitBeforeStandardAge.source: SGB VI §34 (as amended by the 8. SGB IV-Änderungsgesetz)

countTowardFortyFiveYears.note: Compulsory contribution periods (and equivalent periods) of EU/EEA/Swiss and agreement countries count toward the 45 years when they come from a system in which work is what makes people insured.
countTowardFortyFiveYears.source: DRV, verbindliche Entscheidungen: Prüfung der Wartezeit von 45 Jahren (2 May 2008): https://www.deutsche-rentenversicherung.de/DRV/DE/Ueber-uns-und-Presse/Struktur-und-Organisation/Selbstverwaltung/verbindliche-entscheidungen/2008/20080502_Pruefung_wz_45_jahre and bilaterale Abkommen (10 June 2009): https://www.deutsche-rentenversicherung.de/DRV/DE/Ueber-uns-und-Presse/Struktur-und-Organisation/Selbstverwaltung/verbindliche-entscheidungen/2009/20090610_bilaterale_sv_abkommen_wz_45_jahre

residenceBasedPeriodsTowardFortyFiveYear.note: Periods in a residence-based pension system (e.g. Swiss AHV years without work) are assumed not to count toward the 45 years unless they're periods of work.
residenceBasedPeriodsTowardFortyFiveYear.source: Inferred from the DRV decision of 2 May 2008 (work-based systems only); no text read on residence-based systems

foreignPeriods.source: VO (EG) 883/2004 Art. 6, Art. 52 Abs. 4 and Anhang VIII (Germany), Art. 57; applied to the EEA and, through the EU–Swiss free-movement agreement, to Switzerland

proposals.note: Alterssicherungskommission (June 2026): standard age linked to life expectancy after 2031 (67.5 in 2041, 68 in 2051); the 45-year pension at 65 abolished; the 35-year pension from 64. Test with the de.drv option ageIncreaseMonthsPerYear.

claims.note: Claim options are listed up to this age (later if the standard age passes it). The scheme option ageIncreaseMonthsPerYear (default 0) adds months to every claim age for each year from ageIncreaseFromYear, to test the proposed link to life expectancy after the Haltelinie ends in 2031.
claims.source: Module choice, from the design (docs/tax/DE.md, Statutory pension); Alterssicherungskommission proposal: https://www.bmas.de/DE/Soziales/Rente-und-Altersvorsorge/Rentenreform-2025/Rentenkommission-2026/rentenkommission-2026.html

taxableShare.note: By the year the pension started: 2025 83.5%, 2026 84%, 2030 86%, 2040 91%, 2058 100%. For DRV, foreign statutory pensions and Rürup.
taxableShare.source: EStG §22 Nr. 1 Satz 3 Buchst. a Doppelbuchst. aa (Wachstumschancengesetz: +0.5 points a year from 2023): https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__22.html; DRV, rvRecht: https://rvrecht.deutsche-rentenversicherung.de/SharedDocs/rvRecht/04_GRA_Sonstige/EStG/gra_estg_p_0022.html

fixedExemption.note: From the year after the pension starts, the exempt part is fixed in euros: (1 - share) * that year's pension. Later increases are taxed in full.
fixedExemption.source: EStG §22 Nr. 1 Satz 3 Buchst. a Doppelbuchst. aa Satz 4-6

annuityIncomeShare.note: Ertragsanteil for private annuities and the over-mandatory part of Swiss BVG pensions (not Rürup, Riester or bAV), by the age completed when the annuity starts: the first band whose upToAge is at least that age. Every row was cross-checked in October 2026 against the Finanzverwaltung NRW's table and independent extracts (56: 26%, 62: 21%, 68: 16%, 61: 22%, 63: 20%, 65: 18%).
annuityIncomeShare.source: EStG §22 Nr. 1 Satz 3 Buchst. a Doppelbuchst. bb (table): https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__22.html; Finanzverwaltung NRW, Ertragsanteil bei lebenslangen Leibrenten: https://www.finanzverwaltung.nrw.de/sites/default/files/asset/document/ertragsanteil_bei_lebenslangen_leibrenten.pdf; LV 1871: https://www.lv1871.de/private-rentenversicherung/wiki/ertragsanteilsbesteuerung/; steuertipps: https://www.steuertipps.de/lexikon/e/ertragsanteil-tabelle

ageRelief.note: Altersentlastungsbetrag on non-pension income from the year after turning 64, by that year. Under 3% for cohorts turning 64 around 2050.

foreignOccupational.note: An occupational pension from abroad (other than the Swiss BVG, which treaties.CH.bvgInGermany covers), whose contributions got no German relief, is taxed at the Ertragsanteil like a private annuity (§22 Nr. 5 Satz 2 Buchst. a with Nr. 1 Satz 3 Buchst. a bb). Italian pension-fund annuities are the main case.
foreignOccupational.source: EStG §22 Nr. 5 Satz 2: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__22.html; module assumption for foreign funds (open question on Italian pension funds)

foreignTaxCredit.note: A foreign pension Germany taxes although the plan says the paying country taxes it (a treaty gives it to Germany, or no treaty is in this file): the tax the paying country charged is credited, per country at most the German income tax times that country's income over total income, before the trade-tax credit, Soli and church tax.

kvdr.note: Contributions on statutory pensions (half the general rate and half the Zusatzbeitrag; the DRV pays the other half), foreign statutory and comparable pensions (half, nobody pays the other half), bAV (full rate above the allowance; care on all of it above the threshold) and self-employment income. Nothing on capital income, Riester, Rürup or rent. Care: the full rate, paid by the pensioner. defaultWorkStartAge: the option workStartYear defaults to the birth year plus this (a module default).
kvdr.source: SGB V §5 Abs. 1 Nr. 11 (9/10 rule) and Abs. 2 Satz 3 (3 years per child), §226, §228, §229 Abs. 1 Satz 3, §237, §247, §248; SGB XI §57, §59; GKV-Spitzenverband and DRV, Rundschreiben KVdR: https://www.vdek.com/vertragspartner/mitgliedschaftsrecht_beitragsrecht/krankenversicherung-rentner-versorgungsbezuege-einkommen-renten/_jcr_content/par/download_23269565/file.res/RS-KVdR-24-10-2019.pdf; DRV, rvRecht on §5 SGB V: https://rvrecht.deutsche-rentenversicherung.de/SharedDocs/rvRecht/01_GRA_SGB/05_SGB_V/gra_sgb005_p_0005.html

foreignComparablePensions.note: Foreign pensions comparable to a statutory pension are charged like one under KVdR (half the general rate and half the Zusatzbeitrag). The Swiss AHV and BVG pensions, the BVG's over-mandatory part included, are comparable.
foreignComparablePensions.source: SGB V §228 Abs. 1 Satz 2; BSG 30 November 2016, B 12 KR 22/14 R (AHV): https://www.rechtsportal.de/Rechtsprechung/Rechtsprechung/2016/BSG/Beruecksichtigung-einer-Rente-der-schweizerischen-Alters-und-Hinterlassenenversicherung-Invalidenversicherung-bei-der-Bemessung-der-Beitraege-zur-Krankenversicherung-der-Rentner; BSG 23 February 2021, B 12 KR 32/19 R (BVG): https://www.bsg.bund.de/SharedDocs/Entscheidungen/DE/2021/2021_02_23_B_12_KR_32_19_R.html

foreignPensionCare.note: Care contributions on a foreign statutory pension at the full rate (3.6%, 4.2% childless), paid by the pensioner, as on a German pension.
foreignPensionCare.source: SGB XI §57 Abs. 1, §59 Abs. 1 with SGB V §228 Abs. 1 Satz 2; VdK: https://www.vdk.de/aktuelles/tipp/auch-auf-renten-aus-dem-ausland-werden-krankenkassenbeitraege-faellig/; sozialversicherung-kompetent: https://sozialversicherung-kompetent.de/krankenversicherung/versicherungsrecht/928-krankenversicherung-der-rentner-beitraege.html; perspektiveausland, Auslandsrenten 2026: https://www.perspektiveausland.com/rente-im-ausland/auslaendische-renten-krankenversicherungspflicht-deutschland

periodsAbroadForKvdr.note: Insurance periods in another EU/EEA country or Switzerland count toward the 9/10 rule (Art. 6). So do residence periods in a member country whose health system doesn't depend on insurance or work; the list is the one the KVdR circular gives (the UK, then listed, has since left the EU). Agreement countries only where the agreement says so. countries: the EU and EEA members and Switzerland, whose residence years count toward the 9/10 rule (insured there, or resident in a residence-based system).
periodsAbroadForKvdr.source: VO (EG) 883/2004 Art. 6; GKV-Spitzenverband and DRV, Rundschreiben KVdR (via GGUA, Krankenversicherung der Rentner im Rahmen der EG-Verordnungen: https://www.ggua.de/fileadmin/downloads/ggua/Clearingstelle/KVdR883.pdf); DRV, rvRecht on Art. 6 VO 883/2004: https://rvrecht.deutsche-rentenversicherung.de/SharedDocs/rvRecht/02_GRA_EU_SVA/03_Europarecht/01_VO_EG_Nr_883_2004/art_0001_25/gra_euvo_883_2004_a_0006.html; Bundestag WD 8 - 3000 - 012/24: https://www.bundestag.de/resource/blob/1001032/WD-8-012-24-pdf.pdf

partialExemptionApplies.note: Investment income counts after the partial exemption of §20 InvStG. Secondary sources cite the GKV-Spitzenverband's catalogue of income for it; the catalogue itself couldn't be read.
partialExemptionApplies.source: GKV-Spitzenverband, Katalog von Einnahmen und deren beitragsrechtliche Bewertung nach § 240 SGB V (26 May 2026): https://www.gkv-spitzenverband.de/media/dokumente/krankenversicherung_1/grundprinzipien_1/finanzierung/beitragsbemessung/2026-05-26_Katalog_Einnahmen_beitragsrechtliche_Bewertung_240_SGB_V_BF.pdf, as cited by versicherungenmitkopf: https://www.versicherungenmitkopf.de/kapitalertraege-krankenversicherung

vorabpauschaleCounts.note: Distributions, the Vorabpauschale and sale gains of investment funds all count as capital income.

riesterRuerupCount.note: Private Riester and Rürup annuities count for voluntary members (they're free only under KVdR).

capitalIncomeExpenseAllowance.note: Some funds deduct 51 a year of costs from capital income (TK automatically); not modelled, which overstates contributions by about 11 a year.

voluntary.note: All income: pensions, payouts, interest, gains, rent; between the minimum base and the ceiling. DRV pays half the general rate and half the Zusatzbeitrag of the statutory pension (at most half the contribution or premium). Other income at the reduced rate.
voluntary.source: SGB V §240, §243, §247; SGB VI §106; Beitragsverfahrensgrundsätze Selbstzahler (GKV-Spitzenverband); haufe, Einnahmen aus Kapitalvermögen: https://www.haufe.de/sozialwesen/sgb-office-professional/beitragspflichtige-einnahmen-freiwillig-krankenversicherter-16-einnahmen-aus-kapitalvermoegenvermietungverpachtung_idesk_PI434_HI10152386.html; haufe, Versorgungsbezüge: Besonderheit bei bAV-Riester-Renten: https://www.haufe.de/personal/entgelt/versorgungsbezuege-besonderheit-bei-bav-riester-renten_78_447254.html

pkvSubsidy.note: A pensioner in PKV gets a subsidy from the DRV: half the general rate and half the Zusatzbeitrag of the statutory pension, at most half the premium. Tax-free.

undocumentedCost.note: A sale whose purchase cost isn't known is taxed on 30% of the proceeds as cost (the substitute base), so on 70% of them.

partialExemption.note: Applies to distributions, the Vorabpauschale and sale gains of private investors. Equity funds invest continuously more than 50% in equities, mixed funds at least 25%. fund: bond, money-market and other funds.

vorabpauschale.note: Base income = 1 January value * 70% * Basiszins, at most the year's rise in value plus distributions, less distributions. Deemed received on the first working day of the next year. Deducted in full from the gain on sale.
vorabpauschale.source: InvStG §18 and §19 Abs. 1 Satz 3: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/invstg_2018/__18.html; BMF, Basiszins zum 2. Januar 2026 (13 January 2026): https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/Downloads/BMF_Schreiben/Steuerarten/Investmentsteuer/2026-01-13-basiszins-berechnung-vorabpauschale.pdf

lossOffsetting.note: Losses on shares only offset gains on shares; other losses (funds included) offset any capital income. The 20,000 limit on derivatives was abolished for all open cases (JStG 2024).

lowerTariffOption.note: Günstigerprüfung: all capital income at the tariff when that's lower, keeping the saver allowance and the partial exemption.

foreignTaxCredit.source: EStG §32d Abs. 5; DBA Italien Art. 10 and 11; DBA Schweiz Art. 10 and 11 (treaties.CH.withholding)

privateSales.note: Gains of private sales within the holding period are taxed at the tariff unless their total in the year is under 1,000 (a threshold: at 1,000 or more, all of it is taxed). Gold ETCs with a right to physical delivery count as gold. The planner gives no holding period (TaxKit gap G6), so every sale of gold, crypto or a delivery ETC is treated as held longer than a year: tax-free. The categories are the planner's: a gold ETC with a right to delivery is taxed like gold (BFH VIII R 4/15), stablecoins like crypto, and property (realEstate) is assumed held longer than its 10 years.
privateSales.source: EStG §23 Abs. 1 Nr. 1-2 and Abs. 3 Satz 5 (1,000 from 2024): https://esth.bundesfinanzministerium.de/esth/2024/tabellarische-Uebersicht/Freigrenze-private-Veraeu%C3%9Ferungsgewinne.html; BFH VIII R 4/15 (Xetra-Gold)

otherIncome.note: Crypto staking and lending rewards: a threshold of 256 a year.
otherIncome.source: EStG §22 Nr. 3 Satz 2; BMF, Einzelfragen zur ertragsteuerrechtlichen Behandlung von bestimmten Kryptowerten (6 March 2025)

riester.note: Child grants while child benefit is paid for the child: 300 for children born from 2008, 185 before.
riester.source: EStG §10a, §79-99 (§84 grant, §85 child grant, §86 minimum contribution); AltZertG §1 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 and 4; Altersvorsorgereformgesetz (no new contracts from 2027); weltsparen, Riester-Kinderzulage: https://www.weltsparen.de/altersvorsorge/riester-rente/riester-kinder/; EStG §86 Abs. 1 Satz 4 (minimum own contribution of 60)

residenceOutsideEuEeaHarmful.note: A residence outside the EU and EEA (Switzerland included) when payouts start is a harmful use: grants and tax savings are paid back.

ruerup.note: Deductible within provisions.retirementMaximum together with DRV contributions.

bav.note: 2026: 8,112 tax-free and 4,056 free of contributions a year. The employer adds 15% of converted salary when it saves contributions.
bav.source: EStG §3 Nr. 63; SvEV §1 Abs. 1 Nr. 9; BetrAVG §1a Abs. 1a; aba on the Zweites Betriebsrentenstärkungsgesetz: https://www.aba-online.de/infothek/aktuelles/kurzmeldungen/2026-01-21-zweites-betriebsrentenstaerkungsgesetz-im-bundesgesetzblatt

altersvorsorgedepot.note: Grants: 50% on the first 360 a year and 25% on the next 1,440 (at most 540), plus child grants. Deduction of contributions plus grants with the Riester-style comparison. Earlier payout if a statutory pension is already paid.
altersvorsorgedepot.source: Altersvorsorgereformgesetz (Bundestag 27 March 2026, Bundesrat 8 May 2026): https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2026/kw13-de-altersvorsorge-1156798; BMF FAQ: https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/FAQ/reform-der-privaten-altersvorsorge.html

payoutPlan.note: Years over which the planner spreads payouts from these wrappers, from the first year they can be drawn (WrapperRule.preferredPayoutYears). Riester, Rürup and bAV pay annuities, which the planner can't enforce (TaxKit gap G9); an even payout over these years stands in for one. The Altersvorsorgedepot's payout plan runs from 65 to at least 85.
payoutPlan.source: Module assumption (docs/tax/DE.md, Private pensions and G9)

foreign.note: Payouts from foreign tax-deferred wrappers while resident in Germany: an Italian pension fund or a Swiss pillar 3a is taxed on its gain (payout less what was paid in) at the tariff, half of it after 12 years of membership and from 62, as for a capital life insurance. A Swiss vested-benefits account like a BVG lump sum. The Italian TFR isn't taxed in Germany (Italy taxes it as pay for work there) but counts for the progression clause at one fifth. Any other tax-deferred wrapper: the payout in full at the tariff.
foreign.source: By analogy with EStG §20 Abs. 1 Nr. 6 Satz 2; DBA Italien Art. 15, 18 and 24 Abs. 3; DBA Schweiz Art. 18; BMF letter of 27 July 2016 (BVG): module assumptions

inheritance.note: Per heir. lineal: from a parent (the heir is a child). grandparent: the heir is a grandchild whose parent is alive. relative: class II (nephews, nieces, in-laws); cousins, aunts and uncles are class III (use other). The rate applies to the whole taxable amount; hardship relief caps the tax above a limit at the tax at the limit plus half (three quarters above 30%) of the excess. The Federal Constitutional Court heard a challenge in October 2026. parent: the heir is a parent of the deceased (class I, 100,000); a gift to a parent is class II (giftRelationships). Windfalls of kind gift or gift.<relationship> are taxed like inheritances; gifts within 10 years aren't added together.

instalments.source: AStG §6 Abs. 4 (seven yearly instalments for company shares); whether InvStG §19 Abs. 3 carries it over to funds is unconfirmed

returnWithinYears.source: AStG §6 Abs. 3 (return within seven years cancels the tax for company shares); whether InvStG §19 Abs. 3 carries it over to funds is unconfirmed

exitTax.note: A deemed sale on leaving German residence. Funds (ETFs included) since 1 January 2025. The planner only warns until TaxKit can see a residence ending and per-fund costs (DE.md, G7).
exitTax.source: AStG §6; InvStG §19 Abs. 3 and §49 Abs. 5 (JStG 2024); KPMG: https://kpmg.com/de/de/themen/corporate-governance-und-compliance/kpmg-steuertipps/steuertipp-wegzugsbesteuerung-ab-2025.html

socialSecurityPensions.rule: Taxed only in the paying state if the recipient is a national of that state and not of the other; otherwise only in the state of residence.
socialSecurityPensions.source: DBA Italien 1989 Art. 18, Art. 19 Abs. 4 and Protocol Nr. 14 Buchst. e; BFH 17 August 2022, I R 17/19: https://www.bundesfinanzhof.de/de/entscheidung/entscheidungen-online/detail/pdf/STRE202310062?type=1646225765

tfr.rule: Italy, as pay for work done there; Germany exempts with the progression clause.
tfr.source: DBA Italien Art. 15 and Art. 24 Abs. 3

method.value: Germany exempts with progression (employment income, public pensions, property) and credits (dividends, interest).

nationalityUnknown.rule: Residence state (Art. 18), with a warning, when the plan's citizenship is empty.

socialSecurityPensions.rule: Residence state only (AHV, BVG and DRV pensions, annuities and lump sums), whatever the nationality.
socialSecurityPensions.source: DBA Schweiz 1971 Art. 18; Taxpertise, Besteuerung deutsche Rente bei Wohnsitz in der Schweiz: https://www.taxpertise-online.de/Expertisen/2024/Internationales-Steuerrecht/Besteuerung-deutsche-Rente-bei-Wohnsitz-in-der-Schweiz; MME, Rückkehr nach Deutschland: https://www.mme.ch/de-ch/magazin/artikel/rueckkehr-nach-deutschland-besteuerung-von-renten-aus-schweizer-vorsorge-0

publicServicePensions.rule: Paying state (Art. 19), as clarified by the 2023 protocol.
publicServicePensions.source: DBA Schweiz Art. 19; Änderungsprotokoll of 21 August 2023, in force 27 November 2025, applied from 2026: https://www.sif.admin.ch/de/inkrafttreten-des-aenderungsprotokolls-zum-doppelbesteuerungsabkommen-mit-deutschland

bvgInGermany.mandatoryPart: cohort taxable share (Leibrente §22 Nr. 1 Satz 3 a aa), annuities and lump sums alike
bvgInGermany.overMandatoryLumpSum: like a life insurance with a capital option: tax-free for membership before 2005, otherwise the gain
bvgInGermany.note: German residents with Swiss pension-fund benefits. Without the split, everything is treated as mandatory (overstates tax).
bvgInGermany.source: BMF letter of 27 July 2016 (IV C 3 - S 2255/07/10005 :004): https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/Standardartikel/Themen/Steuern/Internationales_Steuerrecht/Staatenbezogene_Informationen/Laender_A_Z/Schweiz/2016-07-27-Schweiz-vorsorgeeinrichtungen-nach-der-zweiten-saeule-der-schweizerischen-altersvorsorge.pdf; BFH 26 November 2014, VIII R 38/10 (haufe: https://www.haufe.de/steuern/rechtsprechung/kapitalleistungen-schweizerischer-versorgungseinrichtungen_166_308214.html); Deloitte: https://www.deloitte-tax-news.de/arbeitnehmerentsendung-personal/thema-des-monats/bmf-schreiben-zur-steuerlichen-einordnung-von-schweizerischen-pensionskassen-in-deutschland-vom-27072016.html

bvgLumpSumOneFifthRule.note: Whether the one-fifth rule applies to a mandatory-part lump sum; the BFH denied it for a freely chosen capital option in German bAV.
bvgLumpSumOneFifthRule.source: Secondary: haufe on BFH VIII R 38/10; magnus-gmbh on BFH case law: https://www.magnus-gmbh.de/themen/keine-steuerermaessigung-fuer-vertragsgemaesse-kapitalauszahlung-durch-pensionskassen/

pillar3aInGermany.rule: The gain (payout - contributions) at the tariff, half after 12 years and from 62, with a warning.
pillar3aInGermany.source: No ruling found; module assumption by analogy with §20 Abs. 1 Nr. 6

crossBorderCommuters.note: Grenzgänger (live in one state, work in the other and return home regularly): the residence state taxes the salary and credits the work state's withholding of at most 4.5% of gross salary. More than 60 working days without returning home for work: the work state taxes, the residence state exempts with progression. The 2023 protocol adds rules for work from home (verify).
crossBorderCommuters.source: DBA Schweiz Art. 15a; EY: https://www.ey.com/de_de/technical/news-zum-internationalen-mitarbeitereinsatz/dba-schweiz-grenzgaengerregelung; Kanton Zürich, Informationsblatt deutsche Grenzgänger: https://www.zh.ch/content/dam/zhweb/bilder-dokumente/themen/steuern-finanzen/steuern/quellensteuer/informationsblatt_zur_besteuerung_von_deutschen_grenzgaengerinnen_und_grenzgaengern.pdf

extendedTaxationAfterMove.note: A German national (not Swiss) moving to Switzerland after at least 5 years of unlimited German tax liability stays taxable in Germany on German-source income in the year of the move and the 5 following years, with the Swiss tax on it credited (überdachende Besteuerung). Its compatibility with the free-movement agreement has been referred to the EU Court of Justice (verify).
extendedTaxationAfterMove.source: DBA Schweiz Art. 4 Abs. 4; haufe: https://www.haufe.de/id/beitrag/begriff-und-funktion-der-ansaessigkeit-54-abwanderungsbesteuerung-bei-wohnsitzaufnahme-in-der-schweiz-gem-art4-abs4-dba-schweiz-HI15201785.html; Betriebs-Berater: https://betriebs-berater.ruw.de/steuerrecht/urteile/ueberdachende-Besteuerung-gemaess-Art.-4-Abs.-4-Satz-1-DBA-Schweiz-europarechtswidrig-Vorlage-an-den-EuGH-24101

withholding.note: Swiss withholding tax: 15% of dividends is credited in Germany and the other 20 points reclaimed; interest withholding is reclaimed in full (interest is taxed only in the residence state).
withholding.source: DBA Schweiz Art. 10 and 11; Kanton Zürich, Verrechnungssteuer: https://www.zh.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/steuern-natuerliche-personen/wertschriften-verrechnungssteuer.html; DSW, Erläuterungen Schweiz: https://www.dsw-info.de/fileadmin/Redaktion/Dokumente/PDF/Quellensteuer/Formulare/Schweiz-Erlaeuterungsvordruck_2022.pdf

nonResident.note: A non-resident's German income (e.g. a DRV pension taxed in Germany under the treaty) is taxed without the Grundfreibetrag and the special-expenses lump sum, unless at least 90% of world income is German-taxed or the rest is under the Grundfreibetrag; then, on application, as a resident, with the rest counted for the progression clause (§32b Abs. 1 Nr. 5). The module sees only the German pensions the plan says Germany taxes, so the rest is what the treaty leaves of them to the country of residence.
nonResident.source: EStG §1 Abs. 3 and 4, §1a, §32b Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 5, §49 Abs. 1 Nr. 7, §50 Abs. 1 Satz 2-3

tradeTax.note: For de.trader: base amount = (profit rounded down to 100 - 24,500) * 3.5%; trade tax = base amount * hebesatz (at least 2.0). Not deductible. Credited against income tax at 4.0 * base amount, at most the trade tax and the income tax on the business income. Additions (Hinzurechnungen) not modelled.
tradeTax.source: GewStG §11 Abs. 1-2, §16 Abs. 4; EStG §35 Abs. 1, §4 Abs. 5b; steuerschroeder, Gewerbesteueranrechnung: https://www.steuerschroeder.de/Steuerrechner/Gewerbesteueranrechnung.html; onlinebilanz: https://onlinebilanz.de/gewerbesteuer-berechnen-hebesatz-freibetrag-anrechnung/
